title: Restricting a single torsion-controlled local model
statement: Let $X,J,H,N$ be as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], with $X$ Noetherian, and let $W\subseteq U$ be arbitrary opens. Supply coherent modules $H_U=H|_U$ and $F$ on $U$, $a:F\to H_U$ with actual kernel and cokernel killed by a positive power of $J|_U$, and $\beta:N|_U\cong F^\wedge$. Supply an over-site module $L$, an isomorphism $l:\operatorname{overEquiv}_U(L)\cong F$, and maps $b:L\to H|_{\operatorname{Over}(U)}$, $q_n:L\to N_n|_{\operatorname{Over}(U)}$ normalized by $l a$ and $l\pi_{F,n}\beta_n^{-1}$. For any coherent $H_W$ identified with $\operatorname{overEquiv}_W(H|_{\operatorname{Over}(W)})$, there exist a coherent $F_W$, an isomorphism $l_W:\operatorname{overEquiv}_W(\operatorname{overMap}_{W\to U}L)\cong F_W$, a map $a_W:F_W\to H_W$, and an isomorphism $\beta_W:\operatorname{overEquiv}_W(N|_{\operatorname{Over}(W)})\cong F_W^\wedge$. The actual kernel and cokernel of $a_W$ are killed by a positive power of $J|_W$. Transferring the restricted b gives $l_W a_W$, after the specified identification of $H_W$, and transferring each restricted q gives $l_W\pi_{F_W,n}\beta_{W,n}^{-1}$. This statement compares no two different local models.

proof.text: Let f = X.homOfLE h, R its restriction, T its tensor pullback. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives t:T≅R. Construct Fw=R(F), and transfer the proved coherent_pullback helper from FormalSystemsPullback along t, using the locally Noetherian coherence criterion and transported local generators. Define lw=overMapCompOverEquiv(L) followed by R(l).

Use hHlocal, overFunctorEquiv U, overMapCompOverEquiv, overFunctorMap and hHw to construct eH:R(Hlocal)≅Hw. Define aw=R(a) followed by eH. Naturality of overMapCompOverEquiv and R(hb), with cancellation of the comparison isomorphisms, proves b normalization.

Use the proved completionPullbackIso and powerQuotientIso_π helpers of FormalSystemsPullback. Conjugate by t and its inverse to get gamma:completion(F)⋙R≅completion(R(F)). Its projection equation follows from naturality of t, powerQuotientIso_π, cokernel.π_desc and isomorphism cancellation. Identify the twice-comapped ideal with J.comap W.ι using comap_comp and homOfLE_ι.

Assemble betaW using the inverse overFunctorMap, overMapCompOverEquiv, overFunctorEquiv U, R(beta), and gamma. Postcompose q normalization with betaW; cancel overFunctorMap, use naturality of overMapCompOverEquiv and R(hq), cancel R(beta inverse) against R(beta), and use the gamma projection equation.

The actual kernel and cokernel of a are quasi-coherent. Apply the proved powerProduct_pullback_zero helper of FormalSystemsPullback to their zero products and the proved powerProduct_zero_of_iso helper of TorsionControlledFormalRestriction to t. Restriction preserves kernels and cokernels. Compose the preservation isomorphisms with the kernel/cokernel comparisons for postcomposition by eH, and transport the zero products through these isomorphisms. Retain the original positive exponent.

lean.statement:
theorem torsionLocalModel_restriction
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H : CoherentModules X) (N : CoherentFormalModule X J)
    (U W : X.Opens) (h : W ≤ U)
    (Hlocal F : CoherentModules U.toScheme)
    (hHlocal : Hlocal.obj = (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj H.obj)
    (a : F ⟶ Hlocal)
    (β : N.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι ≅
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap U.ι) F.obj)
    (ha : ∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
        (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap U.ι).toModulesι s).2 (kernel a.hom)) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
        (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap U.ι).toModulesι s).2 (cokernel a.hom)))
    (L : SheafOfModules ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
    (l : (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj L ≅ F.obj)
    (b : L ⟶ H.obj.over U) (q : ∀ n : ℕᵒᵖ, L ⟶ (N.obj.obj n).over U)
    (hb : (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map b ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app H.obj ≫ eqToHom hHlocal.symm =
        l.hom ≫ a.hom)
    (hq : ∀ n : ℕᵒᵖ, (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map (q n) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app (N.obj.obj n) =
        l.hom ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap U.ι) (n.unop + 1) F.obj ≫ β.inv.app n)
    (Hw : CoherentModules W.toScheme)
    (hHw : Hw.obj = (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv W).functor.obj (H.obj.over W)) :
    ∃ (Fw : CoherentModules W.toScheme)
      (lw : (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv W).functor.obj
        ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
          (homOfLE h : W ⟶ U)).obj L) ≅ Fw.obj)
      (aw : Fw ⟶ Hw)
      (βw : (N.obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.overFunctor (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) W ⋙
          (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv W).functor) ≅
        formalCompletionSystem (J.comap W.ι) Fw.obj),
      (∃ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap W.ι).toModulesι s).2 (kernel aw.hom)) ∧
        IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower (J.comap W.ι).toModulesι s).2 (cokernel aw.hom))) ∧
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv W).functor.map
          ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
              (homOfLE h : W ⟶ U)).map b ≫
            (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
              (homOfLE h : W ⟶ U)).hom.app H.obj) ≫ eqToHom hHw.symm =
        lw.hom ≫ aw.hom ∧
      (∀ n : ℕᵒᵖ, (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv W).functor.map
          ((SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
              (homOfLE h : W ⟶ U)).map (q n) ≫
            (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
              (homOfLE h : W ⟶ U)).hom.app (N.obj.obj n)) =
        lw.hom ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap W.ι) (n.unop + 1) Fw.obj ≫ βw.inv.app n)
